Peripheral IV cannulas that are in use should generally be flushed with 0.9% sodium chloride before and after each medication or infusion, and at least every 8–12 hours (commonly every 12 hours, or every 8 hours in some local policies) if the cannula is left in but not being used. Use a pre-filled saline syringe of at least 5–10 mL with a pulsatile push-pause technique. Follow your local hospital policy, since intervals and volumes vary (for example, with central lines or in neonates).
